unlisted_practices: Generating population-weighted case vignettes from real-world triage data to evaluate digital triage and symptom-checker tools
Using embedding-based clustering and simulated-annealing optimization to derive representative test cases

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an empirical data-driven framework combining sentence embeddings and LLM prompting to generate population-weighted clinical vignettes for evaluating digital triage tools, but it does not test a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
